mechanism_narrative: A rising GDPC1 indicates strong economic demand, which should positively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 growth is positive but S&P 500 returns are negative more than 50% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in UNRATE below 4% signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 returns in the next 5 days.
failure_condition: UNRATE drops below 4% but S&P 500 returns are not positive.

mechanism_narrative: When both UNRATE and FEDFUNDS increase, it indicates tightening monetary conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: Both UNRATE and FEDFUNDS increase but S&P 500 returns are positive.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, rising CPIAUCSL indicates inflationary pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 returns in 20 days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL rises but S&P 500 returns are positive.

mechanism_narrative: Increasing INDPRO signals strong supply and production, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: INDPRO growth is positive but S&P 500 returns are negative more than 50% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: FEDFUNDS above 4.5% indicates high interest rates, leading to negative S&P 500 returns in 20 days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5% but S&P 500 returns are positive.

mechanism_narrative: When both PAYEMS and RSAFS increase, it signals strong labor and demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns in 5 days.
failure_condition: Both PAYEMS and RSAFS increase but S&P 500 returns are negative.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, increasing HOUST indicates housing market strength, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: HOUST increases but S&P 500 returns are positive.
